title: At the restaurant
subtitle: En el restaurante
review: Written by Claude in Latin American (Mexican) Spanish. Check the Spanish, the English and the notes before recording audio. English support only.

categories.desc: A table, the menu, and a little more time.
cards: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
Buenas tardes. Una mesa para dos, por favor.
Good afternoon. A table for two, please.
Could you bring me the menu, please?
La carta or el menú: the menu. ¿Me trae…?: could you bring me…?
Disculpe, ¿me trae la carta, por favor?
Excuse me, could you bring me the menu, please?
Es mi primera vez aquí. ¿Qué me recomienda?
It's my first time here. What do you recommend?
When you need more time to choose.
— Ready to order? — Not yet, thank you.

categories.desc: Saying what you want, and how hot you want it.
cards: Para mí, los tacos de pollo, por favor.
I'll have the chicken tacos, please.
I'd like a lemonade with no ice.
Picar: to be hot and spicy. The answer is often 'poquito', which is not always true.
— Is the salsa spicy? — A little.
Unas enchiladas sin chile, por favor.
Some enchiladas with no chili, please.
Another one of the same, please.

categories.desc: The check, the card, the tip and a compliment.
cards: In Mexico the waiter does not bring it until you ask.
Do you take cards, or cash only?
La propina: the tip. It is usually not included.
Excuse me, is the tip included?
Estuvo: it was, about a meal just finished.
Thank you very much, everything was delicious.
